candidate_sentence_map.S1: Telia Lietuva reported strong growth in the first half of 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased 7.2% year on year to EUR 259.1 million, supported by higher mobile services, fixed services and equipment sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Mobile services revenue rose 8.3% to EUR 100.0 million, fixed services increased 5.3% to EUR 112.9 million, and equipment sales grew 9.6% to EUR 46.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Within fixed services, IT services were particularly strong, increasing 23.9%.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: EBITDA rose 9.5% to EUR 105.5 million, with the margin increasing to 40.7% from 39.9%.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items increased 10.2% to EUR 106.9 million, and the adjusted margin reached 41.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Operating profit grew 15.1% to EUR 62.4 million, while profit before tax increased 16.6% to EUR 61.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Profit for the period rose 14.7% to EUR 51.3 million, increasing the profit margin from 18.5% to 19.8%; earnings per share rose from EUR 0.077 to EUR 0.088.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Cost of goods and services increased 2.3%, reflecting higher equipment sales volumes and increased network interconnection and roaming costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Operating expenses rose 11.3%, mainly because of higher energy costs, external IT services and common Group-function expenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company also recorded EUR 1.4 million of non-recurring redundancy expenses related to restructuring its Digital & Technology unit.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Cash generation strengthened, with net cash from operating activities up 15.0% to EUR 103.1 million and free cash flow up 12.5% to EUR 64.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Capital investments increased 57.9% to EUR 37.5 million, including EUR 9.7 million for 5G spectrum licenses, higher mobile-network and IT investment, and continued infrastructure development.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: As a result, the company ended June with net cash of EUR 4.3 million, compared with net debt of EUR 27.5 million a year earlier.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Major developments included the acquisition of two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million and extension of rights to use the 2,100 MHz band for EUR 2 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The company also announced EUR 7.1 million of 2026 mobile-network investment and began construction of a new data center near Vilnius, with planned investment of up to EUR 26 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: In May, it paid EUR 81.6 million in dividends for 2025, or EUR 0.14 per share.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: The candidate summary adequately covers most core material information: revenue growth (K1), EBITDA achievement (K2), capital investment surge (K3), free cash flow increase (K4), spectrum acquisitions (K5), planned network investment (K6), dividend distribution (K8), and data center construction (K9). However, it omits the specific information about mobile data traffic growth in Lithuania (K7) and the appointment of Vaidas Dominauskas as Head of Enterprise (K10). These omissions are important but do not fundamentally alter the overall financial picture presented, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
